item.title: IEA vows to deepen ties with Tajikistan: Muttaqi
item.description: Afghanistan’s Foreign Minister emphasized that friendly relations and mutual trust between Afghanistan and Tajikistan remain inviolable, affirming the Islamic Emirate of Afghanistan’s strong commitment to expanding political, economic, trade and cultural cooperation with its neighbor.

item.title: Bid to smuggle 38,000kg of silver foiled in Kandahar
item.description: Security forces have foiled an attempt to smuggle 38,000 kilograms of silver in southern Kandahar province.

item.title: France pledges €2m for earthquake relief in eastern Afghanistan
item.description: The Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) and the United Nations Children's Fund (UNICEF), with financial support from France, have launched a €2 million program to assist families affected by the August 2025 earthquake in eastern Afghanistan.
